title: Great Zimbabwe Stone Walls

scenes.text: Over 150,000 stone blocks form a hidden city

scenes.query: satellite view of Great Zimbabwe plateau
scenes.text: Great Zimbabwe rises near modern Masvingo, Zimbabwe, on a granite plateau.
The walls stand up to 11 meters tall without mortar.

description: Great Zimbabwe’s massive dry‑stone walls tower over the landscape, yet their builders and purpose are still debated. Explore the clues left in stone.
